articles.title: Hunga eruption reshaped stratospheric water and ozone with limited climate cooling
articles.summary:
Sydney, Australia (SPX) Jan 05, 2026


A new international assessment details how the January 2022 eruption of the Hunga Tonga-Hunga Haapai volcano in the South Pacific altered the stratosphere, atmospheric chemistry, and radiation while having only a small impact on global surface climate and the Antarctic ozone hole.

articles.summary:
Berlin, Germany (SPX) Jan 01, 2026


A multinational research team led by UiT The Arctic University of Norway has identified the deepest known gas hydrate cold seep on Earth during the Ocean Census Arctic Deep - EXTREME24 expedition, documenting the Freya Hydrate Mounds at 3,640 meters depth on the Molloy Ridge in the Greenland Sea.
